activity_statements.statement: discovers, develops and manufactures medicines serving 55+ million patients annually across therapeutic areas including diabetes/obesity, oncology, immunology and neuroscience
commercializes high-demand medicines including GLP-1 receptor agonists for diabetes and obesity (tirzepatide under Mounjaro and Zepbound brands) to patients and healthcare systems globally
invests at record levels in US pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity to meet strong demand for its medicines including expansion of API and drug product facilities
runs patient access programs and works with health organizations, providers, regulators and governments to improve medicine affordability for the 55M+ people who count on Lilly medicines
maintains a 149-year history of pharmaceutical research with approximately 47,000 employees worldwide dedicated to medicine development and delivery

name_reality_gap: Labeled Pharmaceutical Manufacturing; reality is a research-led organization that is currently the world's most valuable pharmaceutical company driven by GLP-1/obesity medicines, with manufacturing capacity expansion as a primary strategic challenge — the label undersells the discovery-science and market-access dimensions.
